chunks: From him, from ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

Regarding the salat of the two Eids, he said: He says takbīr, then recites, then says takbīr five times, making qunūt between every two takbīrs. Then he says the seventh takbīr and performs rukūʿ with it. Then he performs sajdah. Then he rises in the second rakʿah and recites, then says takbīr four times, making qunūt between every two takbīrs. Then he says takbīr and performs rukūʿ with it.

key_terms.صَلَاةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ: the salat of the two Eids

ai.seo_question: How is the takbīr performed in the salat of the two Eids according to Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner of takbīr in the salat of the two Eids. It outlines the sequence of recitation, repeated takbīrs, qunūt between them, and proceeding to rukūʿ in each rakʿah, serving as a fiqh narration on the ritual form of Eid prayer.
